tvShow.name: My Brilliant Career
tvShow.overview: Restless, razor-sharp and refusing to conform, 17-year-old Sybylla Melvyn is dead set on writing her own story in an era that expects her to find a man and settle down.

episodes.name: REVOLT
episodes.overview: Sybylla is sent to her posh grandmother to be polished for marriage, but her spirited nature leaves a bold impression on high society.

episodes.name: HE
episodes.overview: Sybylla gains a fan from her antics at the party who encourages her to pursue her writing career. She also develops a little crush on someone.

episodes.name: YAH!
episodes.overview: A well-loved family member returns to Caddagat along with a charming guest. Sybylla's talents are recognized and she receives an unexpected offer.

episodes.name: TO LIFE!
episodes.overview: Things at home get more dire but it's time to have some fun. Everyone lets loose at the New Year's party where feelings and tensions rise.

episodes.name: ONE GRAND PASSION
episodes.overview: Secrets and feelings get exposed and everyone is feeling it all. Sybylla makes a huge decision about her future.

episodes.name: TA TA
episodes.overview: Sybylla struggles as a governess but amid chaotic classrooms and never-ending chores, she realizes the value of sacrifice and pursuing her dreams.
